paragraphs: Mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:1, where Rabbi Yonah reports in his name.

notes.text: The locator ה״איו is malformed and needs a source check.

The saved named Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Demai chapter 2, first halakhah, explicitly has Yonah reporting in the name of Shimon ben Zekharyah. It supplies a 2:1 comparison without resolving every letter of ה״איו. The source heading’s bar and the witness’s ben are retained distinctly; no mixed historical note is retired.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. III, p. 1174) has the same unusual letters following the chapter and halakhah markers. The matching passage in Yerushalmi Demai 2:1 gives Rabbi Yonah reporting in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Zekharyah. Hyman’s heading has bar. The passage establishes the citation while leaving the rest of the printed locator unexplained.
